line: [warm, a little in awe] You found Effect.

line: [proud, with a quiet smile] It felt like a superpower.

speaker: Narrator
line: [dry, increasingly tired, speeding up] Generators. Pipes. Layers. Tags. Wrappers... around wrappers.

speaker: Narrator
line: [barely above a whisper, wondering, as if the idea just arrived] What if the language...

line: [barely above a whisper, wondering] just understood?

line: [clear, simple] TypeScript... with Effect built into the language.

line: [bright, confident, conversational] An effect is just a function. And await... is yield star.

line: [bright, confident] Errors live in the signature. Throw means fail.

line: [bright, confident] Catch by type. Whatever you don't handle... stays in the type.

line: [bright, confident] Behaviour reads left to right.

line: [lightly amused] Services and layers... without the incantation.

line: [satisfied, confident] And it all compiles to plain, idiomatic Effect.

line: [hushed, intimate, late at night] Three-oh-seven A.M.

line: [softly, reassuring] Your code already knew what to do.

line: [warm, tender, with a small smile] You slept through it.

line: [slow, sincere] Because you wrote... what you meant.
